findings: Each endpoint comparison implements undirected equality, and the short-circuit scan traverses actual input occurrences, preserving duplicate and reversed-edge semantics. No step invokes whole-list membership.
Four separately lifted scans feed their actual Boolean outputs into the same final Entry in weight/seed/selected/host/drawn order. Every scan handover is represented and charged.
The row and matrix machine constructs entries one at a time, performs literal reverse transitions, retains input order, and accounts for both cell calls and row/matrix termination.

The refinement is literal equality to the unchanged SampleRecords.encode for arbitrary finite endpoint lists and rational weight matrices; finite edge-set deduplication is only in the semantic specification.

The executable result follows the same transition trace with sufficient external fuel; the bound is cellCount*(four input-list lengths+11)+4*rowCount+2, specialized to n squared for square encoded inputs.
boundaries: Natural comparison, rational cell values and one list-cell operation remain atoms in the inherited model. This does not establish bit complexity.
Original raw weight matrix and four original endpoint lists are supplied; their framing/serialization and graph/greedy outer update construction remain separate.
The fuel-expression evaluation is not claimed as part of the transition count.
Safety audit, official kernel replays, full production preservation and exact-commit CI are separate gates.
